content: Degisoggu, anmar Cristo-igargi-gebe-onoleddaed-odurdaklemaladgi mer bar egi naigu gumarsun. Nasgumarsun. Mer bar we-igargebe-odurdaklemaladgi gannar-gannar sunmaknai be gumarsun:
Gannar-gannar we-igargangi an bemar-odurdakbisulid, bur an bemar-odurdakbied yoo amba bemar ibmar-durdakmaladgi. Ar Bab-Dummad deyob anga igar-uksale, ar deyob an bemar-odurdakmalodo.
Ar irgwenna dulemar-Bab-Igar-abingasgusmalad, Bab-Dummad-dulemarga-ibmar-uked-abingasmalad, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-nikusmalad.
Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbagi-nanadigusmalad, degi, yoedse-ibmarmar-guoed-e-gangued-itosgusmalad.
We-dulemar, Bab-Jesús-metele, gannar Jesúsʼse aibirye-sogele, gege gannar bar aibired. Ar degiile, gannar Bab-Dummad-Machi-Jesús-nakrusgi-bioknaido, degi, dulemar-asabin egi dodonaido.
Ar dii bali-bali-wiedbali, napa nue-dii gobed. Degidbali, a-napa dule-ibmar-digedga, gagan-nuegan-nabir-gullemalad nue-sanmakega imaked. Bab-Dummadi, a-napagi nued binsaed.
Ar we-napagi ikomar-ainiele, gagan-isganamar-ainiele, gwen nabirsurdo. Bab-Dummadse ukabsaleged bato ega danido, geb we-nainu unni-ogumakleged edarbenai guoed.
Gwenadgan-sabesailamalad, ar anmar weyob sunmakmar-inigwele, anmardi nue-wismalad, bemargardi ibmar-nuegan danikoed. A-ibmardi, abonoleged-igalad.
Ar Bab-Dummad dule-innikidaedsoggu, ega-be-ibmar-imaksad geg ieged. Degi, be Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimaladga-ibmar-imaksagu, Bab-Dummad-nug-sabguedba-be-imaksadi, Bab-Dummad geg ieged.
Degi-inigwele, anmar abedo, bemar na wala-walagwen ibmar-nued-imakdii degisadegu na be-burgwedse imaked. Adi, bemar ibmar-bensulidgi-edarbediid nue-abingamalagar.
Melle be wiegalaga gumar. Bur be dule-Bab-Dummad-bensuli-gudidimaladba, degi, gwae-gwaesulidgi Bab-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad-abingasmaladba, be damarmosun.
Bab-Dummad, ibmar-ukoye-sogsad ukedsegad
Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga ise-sogar-sogsagusgu, an bega-ibmar-ukoye, dule-baid eba-bur-dummad-satesoggu, na dukin Bab-Dummad e-nuggi napiragwadgi sognaigusad.
Deun, sogsad gusad:

content.text: “Napira an bega soged, an bela-bela ise-nued begi binsaoed.

content: Génesis 22:16-17
Abraham we-ega-ibmar-soglesad gwae-gwae abessursoggu, Bab-Dummad-ega-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad abinganonisunnad.
Ar dulemar napiragwadgi ise-sogar-ibmar-sogegala, dule-eba-bur-nug-nikad-nuggi imakdamalad. Ise-sogar-soglegedbi unnigualed, ibmar-baid-bar-niksulid, yog berguardaed.

A-ulale, Bab-Dummad, Abrahamʼga-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad, Abraham-waganga-nue-oyogegala, ede, ibmar-soged-geg-bar-ogwaye, degi, we-ibmar-sogsad-napiraye-sogegala, na dukin e-nuggi-napiragwadgi ise-sogar-imaknonikid, an imakedseye.

Yoedse-ibmar-imakoye-sogsadba, degi, ise-sogar-sogsadba, imaksad. We-ibmar-sogbogwad-geg-gwagedgi, Bab-Dummad sogsad. Degisoggu Bab-Dummad geg gakansaed. Bab-Dummad-anmar-edarbed-abediidgi anmar-gwage nue ogannosmarsunnad.

Igi esnas ur-gasa naidae deyobi, anmar-bensurmalad-edarbediid, anmar-sanburba Bab-Dummadgi nai gumogoed. Degisoggu, sunna anmar Bab-Dummadse dogsunnad, igi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummad Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-mor-naid-yaba dogdae, deyob anmar nabir dogmarmogad.
A-negse Jesús, e-inse anmar-idu dogsad. Adi, anmarga igar egaegar. Agi Melquisedecʼyob dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga degisadegu gunonikid.
